title: Hiremi
introBefore: An AI recruiter inside Bitrix24: ranks hh.ru application volume, resurfaces ready candidates from your CRM, and replies from the card. Product:
features: Ranks applications with a score, A/B/C tiers, and a clear verdict: what fits, what's missing, what blocks the hire.
Own CRM first: for a new role, surfaces top candidates you already know — without fresh sourcing.
hh.ru chats from the Bitrix24 card: messaging and reply templates where decisions happen.
An AI layer on Bitrix — not another ATS and not a Huntflow replacement: triage the flood and reuse your talent pool.
Onboarding under 3 minutes: install in Bitrix24 and hh OAuth with zero manual field mapping.
Applications collect themselves — recruiters call the top of the list first instead of drowning in filters.
